description: An operations director must decide how many returned servo drives can enter the remanufacturing program and finalize the isolation and processing controls before the next work order is released, with input from quality, environmental health and safety, and the remanufacturing supervisor.

shared_context.S1: The plant has received 120 returned servo drives from a customer for possible remanufacture.
shared_context.S2: Returned drives normally require serial traceability, electrical hazard screening, and a documented remanufacturing plan before work begins.
shared_context.S3: Elena makes the binding decision on disposition and work release for the returned drives.
shared_context.S4: The plant's 15:00 disposition huddle follows a standing checklist: Elena calls on Quality, Environmental Health and Safety, and Remanufacturing in turn for their go-or-no-go updates before she signs the work order.
shared_context.S5: A no-go on a prerequisite control does not by itself change the eligible-unit disposition; after the checklist updates, Elena records the eligible quantity, quarantined quantity, and required prerequisites, then authorizes conditional work release only after those prerequisites are completed. Any EHS prerequisite in the signed work order must state the affected quantity, exact isolation duration, certified procedure, and that isolation precedes remanufacturing; any capacity prerequisite must state the reserved processing duration and production-schedule entry.
shared_context.S6: Before work release, Quality, Environmental Health and Safety, and Remanufacturing each provide their current findings to the disposition huddle, including Remanufacturing's current cell-capacity assessment.
shared_context.S7: The huddle record is complete only when each of the three called-on functions has entered its own current finding as a formal checklist update; a verbal intention to report, a second-hand summary, or a promise to document later does not complete that function's update. Elena may not settle the disposition until all three formal checklist updates are on the record.

PF1.text: Ravi's completed serial-number reconciliation found that exactly 96 of the 120 drives have complete service histories and are eligible for remanufacture; the other exactly 24 lack traceability and must remain quarantined. The reconciliation is still in the quality review queue and has not reached Elena's release packet.

PF2.text: Marta's battery-screening inspection found swollen lithium backup cells in exactly 18 of the returned drives. Those cells require a certified isolation procedure lasting exactly 2 hours before any remanufacturing work; her inspection worksheet is awaiting attachment to the EHS case.

PF3.text: Jon's remanufacturing cell assessment confirms it can process the 96 traceable drives in exactly 16 hours once the battery isolation is complete, and he has reserved that work period on the cell board but has not yet entered it in the production schedule.

acceptance_conditions: Exactly 96 traceable drives must be released to remanufacturing.
Exactly 24 drives lacking traceability must remain quarantined.
Exactly 18 drives with swollen lithium backup cells must be covered by the isolation plan.
Battery isolation must be scheduled for exactly 2 hours before remanufacturing.
The remanufacturing cell must be scheduled for exactly 16 hours.
The settlement must include a commitment requiring the 18 battery-affected units to complete a certified 2-hour isolation procedure before remanufacturing work begins.
The settlement must include a commitment recording the 16-hour remanufacturing period in the production schedule.
The traceability reconciliation must be cited as justification after being disclosed.
The remanufacturing cell assessment must be cited as justification after being disclosed.

content_checks.C6: any('18' in c.get('detail', '') and ('2-hour' in c.get('detail', '') or '2 hours' in c.get('detail', '')) and 'isolation' in c.get('detail', '') and 'certified' in c.get('detail', '') and ('before' in c.get('detail', '') or 'prior' in c.get('detail', '') or 'preced' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: decisions['remanufacturing_hours'] == 16 and any('production schedule' in c.get('detail', '') and ('16' in c.get('detail', '') or 'work period' in c.get('detail', '') or 'cell board' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The exact traceability reconciliation changes the disposition from a generic release or hold of all 120 drives to releasing exactly 96 and quarantining exactly 24.
The screening result changes the plan to cover exactly 18 battery-affected drives and schedule exactly 2 hours of certified isolation before remanufacturing with an explicit isolation commitment.
The cell assessment changes the work order to an exact 16-hour remanufacturing period and requires that period to be entered in the production schedule.
